name: xAI

list.label: Grok 4.7
list.source: xAI's model page (https://docs.x.ai/docs/models/grok-4.7, read 2026-09-30): reasoning efforts low, medium, high (default), xhigh, 500,000 context. Price, prompts under 200K (200K and up): $2 ($4) input, $0.50 ($1) cached input, $6 ($12) output.

list.label: Grok 4.6
list.source: xAI's model page (https://docs.x.ai/docs/models/grok-4.6, read 2026-09-30): reasoning efforts low, medium, high (default), xhigh, 500,000 context. Price, prompts under 200K (200K and up): $2 ($4) input, $0.50 ($1) cached input, $6 ($12) output.

list.label: Grok 4.5
list.source: xAI's model page (https://docs.x.ai/docs/models/grok-4.5, read 2026-09-30): reasoning efforts low, medium, high (default), 500,000 context. Price, prompts under 200K (200K and up): $2 ($4) input, $0.30 ($0.60) cached input, $6 ($12) output. xhigh is listed, but the reasoning guide (https://docs.x.ai/docs/guides/reasoning) runs it as high before grok-4.6, so it isn't offered.

list.label: Grok 4.3
list.source: xAI's model page (https://docs.x.ai/docs/models/grok-4.3, read 2026-09-30): reasoning efforts none, low (default), medium, high, 1,000,000 context. Price, prompts under 200K (200K and up): $1.25 ($2.50) input, $0.20 ($0.40) cached input, $2.50 ($5) output. xhigh is listed, but runs as high before grok-4.6 (the reasoning guide), so it isn't offered.

list.label: Grok 4.20 (always thinks)
list.source: xAI's model page (https://docs.x.ai/docs/models/grok-4.20-0309-reasoning, read 2026-09-30): reasoning yes, no effort control (it always thinks: thinkRoom); aliases grok-4.20, grok-4.20-reasoning, 1,000,000 context. Price, prompts under 200K (200K and up): $1.25 ($2.50) input, $0.20 ($0.40) cached input, $2.50 ($5) output.

list.label: Grok 4.20 (no thinking)
list.source: xAI's model page (https://docs.x.ai/docs/models/grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning, read 2026-09-30): reasoning no; alias grok-4.20-non-reasoning, 1,000,000 context. Price, prompts under 200K (200K and up): $1.25 ($2.50) input, $0.20 ($0.40) cached input, $2.50 ($5) output.

altNotes: The Chat Completions fallback (legacy) takes a top-level reasoning_effort, not the Responses API's reasoning.effort. store is a Responses parameter and isn't sent there until a live check shows the legacy endpoint accepts it; that endpoint's retention isn't documented separately. Both UNVERIFIED (B0.4).

errorMap.notes: xAI documents 400, 401, 403, 404, 405, 415, 422 and 429 with no error schema. Out of credit was captured once as a 403 with code personal-team-blocked:spending-limit (third party); the docs only say 'rejected'. No rate-limit headers are documented.

privacy.notes: The prepaid balance needs a separate management key (advanced, opt-in).

player.short: Keeps messages 30 days, encrypted; no training without your permission.
player.keeps: Stored 30 days, encrypted, to check for abuse, then deleted.
player.zeroRetention: A team-wide switch in the xAI console.
player.sets: Asks xAI to keep nothing beyond its 30-day abuse check.

terms.login: API key only (DB6). Subscription login is partner-only.
notes: A pre-generation usage-guideline violation costs $0.05 a request.
Responses with store:false; the Anthropic-style /v1/messages is fully deprecated.
playerNotes: xAI charges $0.05 for each request it refuses under its usage rules.
